name: Woodpecker
description: Woodpecker is a sales-engagement platform for cold-email and LinkedIn campaigns, prospect management, multistep sequences, inbox work, deliverability, lead finding, automation, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned dedicated non-agency API key and one exact positive numeric campaign ID. Agents may read only the bound campaign's privacy-redacted name, native status, and Bounce Shield auto-pause flag. Relay excludes mailbox/LinkedIn accounts, settings, schedules, message content, prospects, activity, mutations, reports, agency impersonation, raw APIs, MCP/CLI, polling, bulk work, downloads, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read campaign status
capabilities.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted status summary for the exact configured Woodpecker campaign ID.

approvalRequired.label: Read campaign status
approvalRequired.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted status summary for the exact configured Woodpecker campaign ID.

blocked.label: Change or run campaigns
blocked.description: Creating, editing, running, pausing, stopping, deleting, scheduling, sequencing, or changing campaign settings and accounts is outside V1.

blocked.label: Access prospects or messages
blocked.description: Prospects, leads, contacts, email addresses, LinkedIn profiles, inboxes, replies, manual tasks, sent activity, and person-level data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private campaign content
blocked.description: Mailbox and LinkedIn account IDs, delivery schedules, subjects, message bodies, variants, snippets, tracking, settings, and raw responses are never returned.

blocked.label: Access account or automation surfaces
blocked.description: Mailboxes, LinkedIn accounts, users, domains, agency/client impersonation, master keys, webhooks, reports, Lead Finder, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call raw or bulk surfaces
blocked.description: Raw REST, MCP, CLI, arbitrary endpoints, list/search/filter queries, pagination, polling, imports, bulk work, downloads, exports, and crawling are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded private campaign status read requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected status read runs without Relay approval while exact campaign binding, fixed endpoint, audit, redaction, and response bounds remain enforced; prospects, messaging, campaign writes, and account automation stay blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated campaign status read and keeps the API key encrypted.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Woodpecker account, active client company, API & Integrations add-on, dedicated non-agency API key, exact preconfigured campaign ID, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task enable the API & Integrations add-on, create a dedicated key directly in the intended non-agency client account, choose one preconfigured campaign, record its exact numeric ID, store both through Relay, then validate key authentication, campaign binding, privacy redaction, approval/denial, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without running, changing, or messaging from the campaign.

evidence.supports: Official v2 reference documents fixed GET /rest/v2/campaigns/{campaign_id}, x-api-key authentication, campaign ID/name/status, Bounce Shield timestamp, and highly private mailbox IDs, settings, schedules, LinkedIn actions, subjects, and message bodies.
Official authentication guide documents customer API keys, per-client company keys, API add-on requirements, and broader agency master-key impersonation that Relay excludes.
Official key guide documents the API & Integrations add-on and support for creating multiple dedicated keys.
Official MCP documentation exposes broad campaign management, prospect operations, message composition, analytics, mailbox integration, and settings; Relay does not mount this raw surface.
Official privacy policy describes personal data such as prospect names, email addresses, and contact details, reinforcing V1 exclusion of person-level data.
